source_audit.source_native_alternative: CheckpointManagerOptions(enable_async_checkpointing=False) resolves to synchronous Checkpointer-backed saving while retaining the same item handlers and checkpoint schema.

interpretation.supported: The asynchronous checkpoint-save implementation is not viable for this single-GPU practical π0.5 state under either 40 GiB or 64 GiB no-swap cgroup limits on the clean 125 GiB host. Both failures occur with fresh step-0 state and zero real training updates.
interpretation.not_supported: The evidence does not justify unlimited host-memory escalation, a different checkpoint format, reduced checkpoint content, or a change to scientific training variables.
interpretation.why_sync_is_next: Orbax 0.11.13 exposes a source-native synchronous mode. Testing that implementation changes checkpoint scheduling/lifetime only and directly targets the observed host-memory staging failure.

next_repair.name: SOURCE_NATIVE_SYNCHRONOUS_CHECKPOINT_SAVE
next_repair.rule: Run synchronous 40 GiB first. Only if it fails specifically by cgroup OOM before completed save/restore may synchronous 64 GiB be authorized. Stop at the first PASS. No memory ceiling above 64 GiB is authorized by this adjudication.
